newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat urged to sack cabinet in corruption report.
newsitem.headline: Arafat urged to sack cabinet in corruption report.

text.p: A Palestinian legislative committee investigating corruption urged President Yasser Arafat on Tuesday to sack his cabinet and put ministers suspected of wrongdoing on trial.

"The committee recommends to the president of the Palestinian Authority to dissolve the cabinet and form a new cabinet made up of technocrats and qualified people," a report to the Palestinian Legislative Council said.

"The president of the Authority should issue his instructions to punish violators against whom there has been proof of guilt and to punish them immediately and to take them to court in order to restore confidence between the Palestinian Authority and its people," the report said.
The committee also recommended Arafat's Authority take legal measures against security forces interfering in civilian affairs such as tax and customs collection.
Another committee, appointed by Arafat, had earlier this month recommended the Palestinian leader put his house in order and that some senior officials be put on trial.
An official auditor found earlier that the Palestinian Authority had squandered $326 million in public funds last year.
